translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: IN YANCUIC TLAHTOLI ICA JESUCRISTO QUEN OQUIHCUILUI IN TETIOTLATITLANIL MATEO

content: In tlalnamictilistli ica in mahtlactli ichpocamen
Ihcuac nimocuepas quen hueyixtoc ipan tetlatequiutilistzin Dios ijcon yes quen oquimpanoc ica in mahtlactli ichpocamen aquin oquihuicaque in tlanexten huan oyahque quinamiquihque in mosihuautiyani.
Macuili san yolmijcamen huan in oc macuili tlanehnehuiliyahque.
In yolmijcamen oquihuicayayahque intlanexten huan ahmo oquihuicayayahque tlen ic quitemitisque intlanex ihcuac sehuisque.
Huan in macuili aquin tlanehnehuiliyahque oquihuicayayahque intlanex ihuan tlen ic quitemitisque intlanex ihcuac sehuisque.
Huan ohuehcau ic oahsico in mosihuautiyani, huan ocochmijque in ichpocamen, huan ocochque.
Oncan cana tlacoyohuac, oquicajque quen ocoutzahtzihque: “¡Ompahuitz in mosihuautiyani. Xiquisacan ic nanquiselisque!”
Nochtehque inon ichpocamen omejque huan oquiyectlalihque intlanex.
Niman in macuili yolmijcamen oquiniluihque in oc macuili aquin tlanehnehuiliyahque: “Xitechmacacan chihton in aceite, tleca yau sehuihque totlanexuan.”

Huan inon ichpocamen aquin tlanehnehuiliyahque oquinnanquilihque: “Ahmo, cana ahmo ahsis ica tehhuan huan ica namehhuan noyojqui. Ocachi cuali xiyacan canin quinemacahque, huan xicohuacan tla mechpolohua.”

Huan ihcuac oyahyaya quicohua aceite inon macuili ichpocamen yolmijcamen, yoahsito in mosihuautiyani. In ichpocamen aquin quipixticaten intlanex ocalajque ihuan ipan in mosihuautilistli, huan hualtlatzajque.
Satepa oahsique in oc sequin ichpocamen, huan oquiluihque: “¡Tlacatzintli, matechtlatlapoluican!”
Huan yehhua oquinnanquilic: “Ic nele ahmo namechixmati.”
Oncan in Jesús omoluihque: ―Xitlamautiyecan namehhuan, tleca ahmo nanquimatihque in tonali niyan in horas queman nihualas nehhuatl aquin Nitetiachicau ica nochin tlacatl.
In tlalnamictilistli ica in tomin

’Ihcuac nimocuepas quen hueyixtoc ipan tetlatequiutilistzin Dios, yes quen oquimpanoc in itlaquehualuan se tlacatl aquin quinequi yas ipan oc se altepetl. Oquinnotz in itlaquehualuan huan oquinmacac in tomin ic matequitican.
’Se de inohque oquimacac cana macuili mil den tomin, huan oc seya oquimacac cana ome mil, huan oc seya oquimacac san se mil. Oquinmacac sehseya quen cuali tequitisque. Oncan oquian ohtli yehhua.
In tlaquehuali aquin oquiseli in macuili mil ic otlaseman, ijcon oquitlan oc macuili mil.
Huan noyojqui ijcon ica in aquin oquiseli in ome mil. Yehhua oquitlan oc ome.
Huan in aquin oquiselic se mil, yehhua oquitlaltocac in tomin den iteco.
’Huan satepa ipan miyac tonali omocuep inon inteco, huan opeu quichihua cuenta inuan.
Achto oahsito in aquin quiselihtoc in macuili mil, huan oquitemacti in oc se macuili mil. Huan oquiluic: “Noteco, onechmacaque macuili mil huan nicanca in oc se macuili mil tlen onictlan.”

Huan iteco oquinanquilic: “Cuali tel, tehhuatl tequin cuali tlaquehuali. Quen cuali otictlatequiuti ica chihton, ic inon nimitztlalis titlatequiutis ica ocachi miyac. Xipehua ica motequiu ica paquilistli.”
Oncan oahsito in oc se tlaquehuali aquin quiselihtoc in ome mil, huan oquiluic: “Noteco, onechmacaque in ome mil, huan nicanca oc ome mil tlen onictlan.”

Huan iteco oquinanquilic: “Cuali tel, tehhuatl tequin cuali tlaquehuali. Quen cuali otitlatequiuti ica chihton, ic inon nimitztlalis titlatequiutis ica ocachi miyac. Xipehua ica motequiu ica paquilistli.”

Huan ihcuac oahsito in tlaquehuali aquin quiselihtoc in se mil, oquiluic in iteco: “Noteco, nehhua onicmat quen tehhuatzin tequin chicahuac tetlahtol, huan masque ayacmo tequitihua ipan tlamiloli, pixcohua miyac, huan mosentlaliya canin ahmo tequitihuahtoc.
Ic inon onimomouti cana nicpolos, huan ic inon onictlaltocac tetomin. Huan nicanca in tlen tehuaxca.”
Huan oquinanquilic in iteco: “¡Ahmo cuali titlaquehuali tlahtziuqui! Tla nele oticmat quen nipixca huan nicsentlaliya canin ahmo nitequiutoc,
tel, ¿tleca ahmo otican inon tomin ipan banco, huan ijcon nicselini notomin huan iconeu?”
Huan oquiluihque in aquin ompa ocahcatca: “Xicuili inon mil huan xicmaca in aquin quipiya in mahtlactli mil.
Tleca ijcon ca; in aquin tequiti ica tlen quipiya, quiahsis ocachi hasta quipiya temoute. Huan in aquin ahmo tequiti ica tlen quipiya, quicuilisque in chihton tlen quipiya.
Huan inon tlaquehuali aquin ahmo otequit, xiquixtohuetzocan quiahuac ipan in tlayohuilotl. Ompa chocasque huan tlantzahtzisque, quen tlocoltiyesque ihcuac quilnamiquisque tlen quichihuanihque.”
In tlixcomacalistli ica in tlalticpac tlacamen
’Ihcuac nihualas nehhuatl aquin Nitetiachicau ica nochin tlacatl, huan nohuan hualasque nochin in ángeles, nimotlalis inahuac tehueyilistzin campa nitlixcomacas.
Mosentlalisque nochin tlacamen den tlalticpac noixpa, huan niquinxexelos quen in tlahpixqui quinxexelohua in calnelohten huan in chivos.
Niquintecpanas ipan noyecman in calnelohten, huan in chivos ic noalrevez.

Ijcon nehhuatl in hueyixtoc niquiniluis aquin caten ipan noyecman: “Xihualacan namehhuan in aquin mechuelitalohtoc ica Notahtzin. Axan Yehhuatzin mechsehuilos ipan tetlatequiutilistzin quen omechyectlalilo queman omochiu in tlalticpactli.
Tleca oniapismic huan onannechtlamacaque. Oniamic huan onannechatliltihque. Oniahantinemiyaya huan onannechsehuihque.
Onechpolo notlaquen huan onannechtlaquentihque. Huan onimococo huan onannechitahque. Onechtzajque huan onannechpalehuihque.”

Huan nechiluisque inon tlamelajcanten: “Totecohtzin, ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique apismicohuatica huan otitetlamacaque. Niyan ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique amicohuatica huan otiteatliltihque.
Huan ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique ahantinemilohuaya huan otitesehuihque. Huan ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique xipetzin huan otitetlaquentihque.
Huan ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique mococolo noso ipan telpiloyan, huan otitepalehuihque.”
Huan nehhuatl in hueyixtoc niquinnanquilis: “Ic nele namechiluiya, nochin tlen onanquichihuilihque ica seya de inohque notlasohicnihuan, aquin ahmo tlen iquisca, no ijcon onechchihuilihque.”

’Oncan nehhuatl in hueyixtoc niquiniluis yehhuan aquin caten ipan nomaalreves: “Ximoihcuanican nonahuac, namehhuan aquin tlahtlacolyohque. Mamechtohuetzocan ipan in tletl den mictlan, in tlen tlayectlalili ica in ahmo cuali tlacatl ihuan iángeles.
Tleca oniapismic, huan namehhuan ahmo onechtlamacaque. Oniamic huan ahmo onannechatliltihque.
Oniahantinemiyaya, huan ahmo onannechsehuihque. Onechpolohuaya notlaquen huan ahmo onannechtlaquentihque. Huan onimococohuaya huan nechtzactoyahque huan ahmo onannechpalehuihque.”

Oncan nechiluisque yehhuan: “Totecohtzin, ahmo tiquilnamiquihque in tla otiteahsique apismicohuatica noso amicohuatica, noso ahantinemilohuaya, noso ihcuac otepolohuaya tetlaquen, noso omococolohuaya, noso otzacuihuatoya, huan ahmo otitepalehuihque.”
Huan nehhuatl in hueyixtoc niquinnanquilis: “Ic nele, namechiluiya, nochin tlen ahmo onanquichiuque ica seya den inihque aquin ahmo tlen iquisca, no ijcon ahmo onanquichiuque ica nehhuatl.”
Niman in inohque quinuicasque campa tlapanosque nochipa huan in tlamelajcanten calaquisque ipan in nemilistli nochipa.
